subject: MSBA High School Building Outreach
overview: The MSBA Communications and Community Engagement Subcommittee finalized website FAQ content and approved a survey for Medford High School staff. They also coordinated with the high school film program to develop an informational video project about the building project.

items.title: Website FAQs Review and Approval
items.summary: Approved the draft website FAQ document outlining project background, the feasibility study, and pending questions about the high school building project.

items.title: Staff Survey Approval
items.summary: Approved a short questionnaire for high school faculty and staff soliciting feedback on facility needs and identifying potential interviewees for a promotional video.

items.title: MHS Video Project Discussion
items.summary: The committee reviewed plans to partner with the high school film and TV production program to produce short video features using staff survey responses.
